title: Bodycam: Entitled College Student Thinks She Makes the Rules
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida police confronting a 23-year-old woman for trespassing in a Tallahassee apartment complex lobby. The complex called 911 on Autum Ledbetter for sleeping in the lobby and folding towels just 12 days after she received a trespassing warning for a similar incident. Ledbetter immediately became combative and refused to give her name to officers. One thing led to another and Ledbetter found herself being carried away in handcuffs. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
